title: Broken and not worth the cost
text: Broken and not worth the cost. I bought this duvet in October, on its 1st use the zipper broke. It opened up with the sliders only slightly closing the gap, not sealing it. An exchange was requested and completed quickly. I received the new one in early November. Now, I have used it on my bed twice, once in December and again in March. I have another duvet so I switch between the two. On this 2nd usage, the zipper has failed yet again. 4 months, 2 uses and a giant waste of time
